summary: Frontend-only branding verification of 'R-A.I.' rendering. Verified BrandName component source, DOM text + codepoints, computed styles, document.title, and visual screenshots on / and /dashboard (desktop 1920 and mobile 390). All checks PASS - brand renders exactly 'R-A.I.' (0x52 0x2d 0x41 0x2e 0x49 0x2e) with monospace font, weight 700, letter-spacing 1.44px. No 'R.Un.io'/'Run.io'/'RUn' variants found in rendered DOM (only false-positive matches inside song lyrics like 'Run the red', 'Outrun').

context_for_next_testing_agent: Branding bug is fixed and verified. brand-name testid present on /, /dashboard (with ' · Admin' suffix), /advertise and LogoWatermark. document.title = 'R-A.I. · Web Radio AI'. Audio/Suno features intentionally not tested in this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous implementation used Unbounded @900 with nested spans, collapsing hyphen/dots visually. Current fix locks the brand to system monospace at weight 700 with 0.08em letter-spacing in a single span; verified rendered codepoints and screenshots show unambiguous 'R-A.I.'.
